locations.HALL_EXT: the exterior of a white stone public verification hall at dawn, a wide flight of pale stone steps, a clean empty plaza, a clear blue-to-gold dawn sky
locations.CITY_NIGHT: a clean modern coastal city at night seen from street level, wide dry streets, crisp white streetlights, an elevated highway, glass towers with lit windows, a clear starry sky

style: Photoreal live-action cinema, shot on a large-format digital cinema camera with a spherical prime lens at f/8, deep focus with every plane sharp from foreground to background, crisp skin pores, individual hair strands and fabric weave, clean clear air, motivated practical light. No fog, no haze, no smoke, no bokeh, no soft focus. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark.
memory_style: Memory replay look: a slightly cool cyan grade with a thin flickering horizontal scanline only along the outer edges of the frame; the image itself stays sharp, clean and fully in focus.
echo_style: Echo fragment look: the memory replay look made slightly warmer, with brief clean white flicker breaks between moments; the image stays sharp and fully in focus, never blurred.
